review_comment: Note that an alternative to use mapper service is manually parsing mapping of each template and see whether there is a `_source.mode attribute` that is set to `synthetic`. However this is error prone.
What happens if the setting doesn't exist but IndexMode is set to `LOGSDB`? Shall we treat it as synthetic?

By using the `Setting#get(...)` method the default is returned if the setting is not defined. In the case of `SourceFieldMapper.INDEX_MAPPER_SOURCE_MODE_SETTING` it fails back to synthetic in the case of logsdb.
